name: AAA Club Alliance (Partner)
desc:
Sales Associate, Travel Contact Center (Remote) | $16.00 to $21.65/hr + Monthly Incentives | Inbound Travel Sales, Upsell Goals
Company: AAA Club Alliance
Industry: Hospitality and Tourism

What Your Day Will Look Like:
You'll help AAA Members and non-Members book trips by phone, email, and web chat. Most bookings are domestic flights, rental cars, train tickets, and hotels, plus hotel stops along a member's road trip route. You'll learn AAA's airline reservation system and travel partner booking sites, with full skill expected within about six months. Customers come to you, and you'll look for chances to suggest add-ons and AAA's preferred travel partners that fit what they need. You'll build relationships so travelers come back to book with you again, and you'll have monthly performance goals.

Soft Skills
- Friendly, relationship-building phone manner
- Listening to understand what travelers want
- Comfort suggesting upgrades and add-ons
- Multitasking across calls, email, and chat
- Problem solving when plans change
assessment: AAA recently updated their hiring assessment. Every applicant now completes a pre-hire assessment that includes basic computer skills, web browser knowledge, technology terminology questions (including things like HDMI and iOS browser navigation), and a typing test. Minimum recommendation is 25 WPM. Applicants below 25 WPM typically receive additional training before being considered. The assessment measures existing knowledge, not something you can prepare for with notes.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: 18 months of sales or customer service experience
Preferred Experience: Call center or inbound call experience

Required Skills:
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Multitasking and problem solving
- A quiet, private workspace with no distractions
- Hard-wired ethernet internet (no Wi-Fi, DSL, hotspot, satellite, or shared connection)
- Able to work weekends, overtime, and holidays as needed
- Must live in an eligible state, and Oklahoma is eligible
- Can't be caring for others in the household while working

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 18 months of retail, hospitality, or call center experience
- Loves travel and enjoys helping people plan trips
- Is comfortable suggesting add-ons and working toward monthly goals
- Wants to learn real airline and hotel booking systems

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Doesn't want any sales or upsell goals
- Can't work weekends, overtime, or holidays
- Is caring for kids or family members at home during work hours
- Doesn't have hard-wired ethernet internet
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Travel reservations
- Air, car, rail, and hotel booking
- Inbound sales
- Upselling and cross-selling
- Customer service
- Call center
- Phone, email, and chat support
- Relationship building
- Meeting performance goals
- Reservation and booking systems

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your sales or customer service experience.
- A member calls to book a hotel for a road trip. How would you find out what they need and suggest options?
- How do you feel about having monthly sales and performance goals?
- Tell us about a time you suggested a product or upgrade that helped a customer. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time a customer's plans changed at the last minute. What happened, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16.00 to $21.65/hr, based on experience and location, plus a monthly incentive plan based on individual performance.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage. Weekends, overtime, and holidays are required as needed.
-Benefits: Full-time gets medical, dental, vision, and prescription, free life insurance, a 401(k) with up to 7% match, 3+ weeks of PTO in the first year, paid holidays, up to 2 weeks paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 a year, discounts, and free AAA Premier Membership.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, all required computer equipment is provided. You need your own hard-wired ethernet internet.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: OMMA friendly
-Notes: Oklahoma is an eligible state, and AAA Club Alliance is a WRO partner. Customers call in, so there's no cold calling, but there are monthly sales and performance goals and upselling is part of the job. Paid virtual training is required. You can't care for anyone in the household while working. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Travel Sales Associate → Travel Agent → Senior Travel Agent → Travel Team Lead → Travel Contact Center Supervisor. This role builds travel booking, inbound sales, and customer relationship skills.
